name: Suzaki Miho
source:
Daughter of Mutsumi and classmate of Takeshi. She and Takeshi have known each other since childhood.

She has a strong tolerance and is eager to take care of Takeshi. As a result, she frequently quarrels with Takeshi.

At first glance, she appears calm and collected, but in front of Takeshi, she has a clear sense of joy, anger, sorrow, and pleasure. Her smile often makes even Takeshi's cheeks turn red.

She is so popular at school that many boys confess their feelings to her. She is even the class president, and her grades are in the upper-middle range.

[From [url=http://ps-web.net/tryset/maman/photo/miho.html]official site[/url]]
